raw_text:
PLAN "12-week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control for Female with T2D"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve body composition and glycaemic control"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Adaptation & Glucose Stabilisation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Fundamentals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_lunge 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_cycle 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Fundamentals":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_bench 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_dumbbell_press 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pull_down 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_shoulders 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Circuit":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_swing 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          TRX_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching_hamstrings 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          bike_easy 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_biceps_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_mobilty 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Metabolic Conditioning":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assault_bike 6x30s rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bodyweight_squat 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          standing_oblique_twist 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          foam_roll 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower Progression":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          single_leg_deadlift 2x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_cycle 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Progression":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          arnold_press 2x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          triceps_rope_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_thoracic 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Hypertrophy Circuit":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          kettlebell_deadlift 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_pushup 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching_quads 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Deload-Ready":
        warmup:
          bike_easy 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Deload-Ready":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_bench 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          band_face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_shoulders 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          light_cycle 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching_full_body 10m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Progressive Overload & Aerobic Base" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Strength Emphasis":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper Strength Emphasis":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up_assisted 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Aerobic Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_state_cycle 30m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Power & Strength":
        warmup:
          dynamic_hamstring 5m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          front_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper Power & Strength":
        warmup:
          band_pull 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_press 4x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          T_bar_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          seated_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "HIIT Low Impact":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assault_bike 8x20s rpe 8 rest 70 seconds
          core_hollow_hold 3x20..30s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Volume Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_cycle 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper Volume Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_bench 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Aerobic Endurance":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          treadmill_walk_incline 35m rpe 6 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload Strength":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Deload Upper":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          band_face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          light_cycle 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 10m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Intensification & Maintenance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength Peak Lower":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          Bulgarian_split_squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Strength Peak Upper":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 5x3..5 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          weighted_pull_up 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mixed Conditioning":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          assault_bike 6x30s rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          farmer_carry 4x40m rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Power & Hypertrophy Lower":
        warmup:
          dynamic 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          leg_press 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          glute_ham_raise 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Power & Hypertrophy Upper":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          triceps_dip_assisted 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Low-Impact HIIT":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing_sprint 8x20s rpe 8 rest 70 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Maintenance Lower":
        warmup:
          walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          Romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          light_cycle 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Maintenance Upper":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_bench 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          one_arm_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          standing_dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Aerobic Recovery":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          steady_state_cycle 20m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 10m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Deload & Test":
        warmup:
          bike 5m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_bench_press 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift 2x3..5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Deload Upper":
        warmup:
          row 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          band_face_pull 2x15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Active Recovery & Education":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 10m
        main straight_sets:
          light_cycle 15m rpe 5 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretching 5m

NUTRITION
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Aim for a modest calorie deficit of ~300-500 kcal/day from estimated maintenance to support fat loss while minimising hypoglycaemia risk."
    - "Protein target: 1.2..1.6 g/kg bodyweight per day to preserve lean mass; prioritise 20-30 g protein at each main meal."
    - "Distribute carbohydrates evenly across meals and prefer low-glycaemic index (GI) sources: legumes, oats, non-starchy vegetables, whole grains. Avoid large carb boluses."
    - "Include fibre-rich foods (25..35 g/day) to blunt postprandial glucose spikes."
    - "Prioritise unsaturated fats (olive oil, nuts, avocados); keep saturated fat moderate."
    - "Meal timing: 3 main meals + 1..2 snacks as needed to avoid long fasting that may increase hypoglycaemia risk while on metformin."
    - "Pre- and post-exercise nutrition: for moderate-intensity sessions, a small carbohydrate + protein snack (15..25 g carbs + 10..20 g protein) may help performance and glucose stability. For morning fasted exercise, monitor symptoms and have quick-acting carbs available."
    - "Hydration: maintain regular fluid intake; avoid sugar-sweetened beverages."
    - "Alcohol: limit intake; if consumed, do so with food and monitor blood glucose."
    - "Medication note: metformin carries low hypoglycaemia risk, but monitor symptoms; coordinate with client's healthcare provider before major dietary or training changes."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    - "Breakfast: Greek yogurt (150g) + 40g oats + 75g mixed berries + 10g nuts — ~25..30g protein, moderate carbs, high fibre."
    - "Snack: 1 small apple + 20g almonds — balanced carb+fat+protein."
    - "Lunch: 120g grilled chicken + large salad (leafy greens, 100g chickpeas, mixed veg) + 1 tbsp olive oil dressing — aim 25..30g protein."
    - "Snack pre-workout (if training): 1 slice wholegrain toast + 1 boiled egg or 150g cottage cheese — 15..25g carbs, 10..15g protein."
    - "Dinner: 120g baked salmon + 150g roasted non-starchy vegetables + 75g quinoa — balanced plate, prioritise veg and protein."
    - "Optional evening snack (if needed): 150g low-fat cottage cheese or 150g Greek yogurt to meet protein targets."
  MACROS:
    - "Protein roughly 25..30% of calories; carbs 35..45% focusing on low-GI; fats 25..35% emphasising unsaturated fats."
  MONITORING:
    - "Check fasting glucose and pre/post-prandial symptoms regularly; consider logging glucose around exercise for first 2..4 weeks."
    - "Track bodyweight weekly and adjust calories if weight loss >0.8% bodyweight/week or <0.25% week over 3 weeks."
    - "Reassess HbA1c with healthcare provider every 3 months."
  SAFETY:
    - "If signs of hypoglycaemia (shakiness, sweating, confusion) occur, treat immediately with 15..20g fast-acting carbohydrate and recheck. Seek medical advice if severe."
    - "Encourage coordination with prescribing clinician for medication adjustments if weight loss or changes in exercise/food intake occur."

NOTES
  - "Progression: increase load when top of rep range is comfortable for two consecutive sessions; prefer small increments (2.5..5%)."
  - "Cardio intensity: keep most aerobic work moderate (RPE 5..6) to enhance fat oxidation and glucose control; include occasional low-impact HIIT as tolerated."
  - "Emphasise sleep (7..9h) and stress management for glycaemic control."
